user.title: Filament Manager
user.description: This adds the Filament sidebar panel and the overview sensors. Manufacturers and filament types are pre-filled and can be edited in the admin area.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Filament Manager is already set up.

data_description.low_stock_threshold: An entry counts as low on stock when it has this many spools or fewer.
data_description.currency: Used by the inventory value sensor, for example EUR.

add_spools.name: Add spools
add_spools.description: Changes the number of sealed spools of an entry.

item_id.name: Entry ID
item_id.description: ID of the filament entry, copied from the manage view.

count.name: Number
count.description: How many sealed spools to add. Use a negative value to remove some.

open_spool.name: Open spool
open_spool.description: Turns one sealed spool into an opened spool with 100 % remaining.

item_id.name: Entry ID
item_id.description: ID of the filament entry, copied from the manage view.

set_remaining.name: Set remaining amount
set_remaining.description: Sets the remaining amount of an opened spool.

item_id.name: Entry ID
item_id.description: ID of the filament entry, copied from the manage view.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: ID of the opened spool. Leave empty to use the first opened spool of the entry.

remaining_grams.name: Remaining in grams
remaining_grams.description: Remaining amount in grams, for example after weighing the spool.

consume_spool.name: Spool used up
consume_spool.description: Removes an opened spool from the inventory.

item_id.name: Entry ID
item_id.description: ID of the filament entry, copied from the manage view.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: ID of the opened spool. Leave empty to use the first opened spool of the entry.
